Question.title: Question
Question.description: A bilingual (Arabic/English) SAAT Physics multiple-choice question with 4 options, answer index, optional chapter sub-part, and explanations.

subPart.description: Optional sub-part number within the chapter (1 to 10)

correct.description: Zero-based index of the correct answer (0-3)

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the question was last updated

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who updated the question

PlatformConfig.title: PlatformConfig
PlatformConfig.description: Global quiz platform settings including the 5-digit student access code and timing configuration.

questionsPerPartQuiz.description: Number of questions per chapter/part quiz

questionsPerComprehensive.description: Number of questions in the comprehensive Chapter 11 exam

secondsPerQuestion.description: Timer duration per question in seconds

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last config update

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who updated the config

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized teacher/admin account allowed to manage the question bank and access code.

/questions/{questionId}.description: Publicly readable SAAT Physics questions; writable only by verified admins.

/config/{configId}.description: Public platform configuration document (configId = 'public'); writable only by verified admins.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Read-only admin registry entries keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
